claude_proposed_widenings.name: companion_active_rider_scope
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Magic-item summon variants need extra passive or ongoing mechanics that apply only while a spawned creature form exists, and sometimes only while the wielder rides that creature.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "While in raven form, the figurine grants you the ability to cast Animal Messenger on it."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: duration_linked_charge_drain_for_spawned_creature
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current item resource model spends charges on activation, but Goat of Traveling spends charges as time passes during the active creature duration and auto-reverts on exhaustion.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "It has 24 charges, and each hour or portion thereof it spends in goat form costs 1 charge."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: spawned_creature_control_randomization
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Obsidian Steed needs a use-time random control state that can ignore commands and then trigger a transport effect when mounted under that state.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "The figurine has a 10 percent chance each time you use it to ignore your orders, including a command to revert to figurine form."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: temporary_item_creation_tied_to_companion_reversion
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Goat of Terror creates temporary magic weapons from the active creature's horns and removes them automatically when the creature reverts.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "The weapons disappear and the horns return when the goat reverts to figurine form."
